mapper.sql: select config_id, config_name, config_key, config_value, config_type, creator, create_time, modifier, update_time, remark from sys_config

SELECT DISTINCT a.notice_id, a.notice_title, a.notice_type, a.notice_content, a.STATUS, a.publish_time, a.receive_end, a.valid_time, a.invalid_time, a.if_all_receive, a.receive_depts, a.receive_roles, a.receive_users, CONVERT ( a.notice_banner, CHAR ) notice_banner, a.remark, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.dept_id, a.tenant_id, b.tenant_name, a.industry_code, ic.industry_name, a.app_ver_code, ivc.app_ver_name FROM sys_notice a LEFT JOIN sys_tenant_info b ON a.tenant_id = b.id LEFT JOIN sys_industry_conf ic ON a.industry_code = ic.industry_code LEFT JOIN sys_industry_ver_conf ivc ON ivc.app_ver_code = a.app_ver_code AND ivc.industry_code = a.industry_code
